name: Deep Freeze
primary:
An icy shell that freezes everyone around where it lands.
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 2.5-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Cold 160: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
self_description:
On you:
• Cold 160: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
